hypothesis_tests.title: 14-Day Guided Onboarding vs. Customer Churn
hypothesis_tests.null_hypothesis: H0: Completing onboarding within 14 days is independent of account churn.
hypothesis_tests.business_verdict: Reject H0. Accounts missing 14-day onboarding churn at 41.5% vs. 15.4% for onboarded accounts (2.7x risk). Mandate automated CS intervention at Day 7 when seat setup < 40%.

hypothesis_tests.title: Support First-Response SLA Breaches (2+) vs. Retention
hypothesis_tests.null_hypothesis: H0: Experiencing 2+ SLA breaches (>8h response) does not elevate churn.
hypothesis_tests.business_verdict: Reject H0. Accounts hit by 2+ SLA breaches churn at 28.1% compared to 20.4% for SLA-compliant accounts. Dedicated P1/P2 triage pod saves high-ARR logos.

hypothesis_tests.title: Annual vs. Monthly Contract Cumulative Account Value
hypothesis_tests.null_hypothesis: H0: Mean cumulative revenue per account is equal across Annual and Monthly contracts.
hypothesis_tests.business_verdict: Reject H0. Annual contracts generate significantly higher realized LTV and cut logo churn from 36.3% down to 10.3%. Incentivize annual prepay with 15% discount.

hypothesis_tests.title: Pricing Experiment: Usage-Hybrid Tier vs. Flat-Seat Control
hypothesis_tests.null_hypothesis: H0: Trial-to-Paid conversion rate is identical between Flat-Seat and Usage-Hybrid pricing.
hypothesis_tests.business_verdict: Reject H0. Usage-Hybrid pricing lifts trial conversion by +50.0% relative while expanding initial ARPU from $1,311 to $1,363/mo.

sql_presets.title: 02 — Monthly MRR Waterfall, NRR % & Quick Ratio
sql_presets.description: CTEs + LAG() & rolling window functions tracking New, Expansion, Contraction, and Churned MRR.
sql_presets.sql:
-- =============================================================================
-- Query 02: Monthly SaaS MRR Waterfall, Net Revenue Retention & Quick Ratio
-- Business Question: How is top-line ARR growing each month, and is growth
-- driven by healthy net expansion (NRR > 100%) or leaky new-logo acquisition?
-- =============================================================================

WITH monthly_movements AS (
    SELECT
        m.month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.is_active = 1 THEN m.account_id END) AS active_accounts,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.new_mrr > 0 THEN m.account_id END) AS new_logos,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.churn_flag = 1 THEN m.account_id END) AS churned_logos,
        ROUND(SUM(m.beginning_mrr), 2) AS beginning_mrr,
        ROUND(SUM(m.new_mrr), 2) AS new_mrr,
        ROUND(SUM(m.expansion_mrr), 2) AS expansion_mrr,
        ROUND(SUM(m.contraction_mrr), 2) AS contraction_mrr,
        ROUND(SUM(m.churned_mrr), 2) AS churned_mrr,
        ROUND(SUM(m.ending_mrr), 2) AS ending_mrr
    FROM fact_mrr_monthly m
    GROUP BY m.month
),
enriched_kpis AS (
    SELECT
        month,
        active_accounts,
        new_logos,
        churned_logos,
        beginning_mrr,
        new_mrr,
        expansion_mrr,
        contraction_mrr,
        churned_mrr,
        ROUND(new_mrr + expansion_mrr - contraction_mrr - churned_mrr, 2) AS net_new_mrr,
        ending_mrr,
        ROUND(ending_mrr * 12.0, 2) AS ending_arr,
        -- Monthly Net Revenue Retention (NRR %) on existing cohort base
        ROUND(
            CASE
                WHEN beginning_mrr > 0
                THEN ((beginning_mrr + expansion_mrr - contraction_mrr - churned_mrr) / beginning_mrr) * 100.0
                ELSE 100.0
            END,
            2
        ) AS monthly_nrr_pct,
        -- Gross Revenue Retention (GRR %) capped at 100% excluding expansion
        ROUND(
            CASE
                WHEN beginning_mrr > 0
                THEN ((beginning_mrr - contraction_mrr - churned_mrr) / beginning_mrr) * 100.0
                ELSE 100.0
            END,
            2
        ) AS monthly_grr_pct,
        -- SaaS Quick Ratio = (New MRR + Expansion MRR) / (Contraction MRR + Churned MRR)
        ROUND(
            (new_mrr + expansion_mrr) / NULLIF(contraction_mrr + churned_mrr, 0),
            2
        ) AS saas_quick_ratio,
        -- Rolling 3-month average Net New MRR using window function
        ROUND(
            AVG(new_mrr + expansion_mrr - contraction_mrr - churned_mrr) OVER (
                ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
            ),
            2
        ) AS rolling_3m_net_new_mrr,
        LAG(ending_mrr) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_mrr
    FROM monthly_movements
)
SELECT
    month,
    active_accounts,
    new_logos,
    churned_logos,
    beginning_mrr,
    new_mrr,
    expansion_mrr,
    contraction_mrr,
    churned_mrr,
    net_new_mrr,
    ending_mrr,
    ending_arr,
    monthly_nrr_pct,
    monthly_grr_pct,
    COALESCE(saas_quick_ratio, 9.99) AS saas_quick_ratio,
    rolling_3m_net_new_mrr,
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN prev_month_mrr > 0 THEN ((ending_mrr - prev_month_mrr) / prev_month_mrr) * 100.0
            ELSE 0.0
        END,
        2
    ) AS mom_mrr_growth_pct
FROM enriched_kpis
ORDER BY month;

sql_presets.title: 03 — Quarterly Cohort Logo & Dollar NRR Matrix
sql_presets.description: Cohort retention matrix tracking logo survival % and dollar expansion from M0 to M11.
sql_presets.sql:
-- =============================================================================
-- Query 03: Quarterly Cohort Logo & Dollar Net Revenue Retention (NRR) Matrix
-- Business Question: How well does each signup quarter retain logos and expand
-- recurring revenue from Month 0 through Month 11?
-- =============================================================================

WITH cohort_base AS (
    SELECT
        a.signup_quarter AS cohort_quarter,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS cohort_size,
        SUM(m0.ending_mrr) AS initial_cohort_mrr
    FROM dim_accounts a
    INNER JOIN fact_mrr_monthly m0
        ON a.account_id = m0.account_id
       AND m0.months_since_signup = 0
    GROUP BY a.signup_quarter
),
cohort_activity AS (
    SELECT
        a.signup_quarter AS cohort_quarter,
        m.months_since_signup AS month_offset,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.is_active = 1 THEN m.account_id END) AS retained_accounts,
        ROUND(SUM(m.ending_mrr), 2) AS cohort_mrr
    FROM dim_accounts a
    INNER JOIN fact_mrr_monthly m
        ON a.account_id = m.account_id
    WHERE m.months_since_signup BETWEEN 0 AND 11
    GROUP BY a.signup_quarter, m.months_since_signup
)
SELECT
    ca.cohort_quarter,
    cb.cohort_size,
    ROUND(cb.initial_cohort_mrr, 2) AS initial_cohort_mrr,
    ca.month_offset,
    ca.retained_accounts,
    ca.cohort_mrr,
    ROUND((ca.retained_accounts * 100.0) / NULLIF(cb.cohort_size, 0), 1) AS logo_retention_pct,
    ROUND((ca.cohort_mrr * 100.0) / NULLIF(cb.initial_cohort_mrr, 0), 1) AS dollar_nrr_pct
FROM cohort_activity ca
INNER JOIN cohort_base cb
    ON ca.cohort_quarter = cb.cohort_quarter
ORDER BY ca.cohort_quarter, ca.month_offset;

sql_presets.title: 04 — B2B RFM & Seat Utilization Customer Segments
sql_presets.description: NTILE(5) window scoring across Engagement, Workflow Frequency, and ARR Monetary tiers.
sql_presets.sql:
-- =============================================================================
-- Query 04: B2B SaaS RFM & Product Adoption Customer Segmentation
-- Business Question: Which active customer accounts are Champions ready for
-- seat expansion vs. High-Value At-Risk accounts requiring immediate CS outreach?
-- =============================================================================

WITH latest_month AS (
    SELECT MAX(month) AS max_month FROM fact_mrr_monthly
),
active_snapshot AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.company_name,
        a.segment,
        a.region,
        a.billing_cadence,
        a.plan_tier,
        m.months_since_signup AS tenure_months,
        m.ending_mrr AS current_mrr,
        ROUND(m.ending_mrr * 12.0, 2) AS current_arr,
        u.seat_utilization_pct,
        u.core_workflow_events,
        u.feature_adoption_score,
        COALESCE(t.sla_breaches_90d, 0) AS sla_breaches_90d
    FROM dim_accounts a
    INNER JOIN fact_mrr_monthly m
        ON a.account_id = m.account_id
    INNER JOIN latest_month lm
        ON m.month = lm.max_month
    LEFT JOIN fact_product_usage u
        ON a.account_id = u.account_id
       AND u.month = lm.max_month
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
            account_id,
            SUM(sla_breached) AS sla_breaches_90d
        FROM fact_support_tickets
        WHERE month >= '2026-07'
        GROUP BY account_id
    ) t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE m.is_active = 1
),
rfm_quintiles AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY feature_adoption_score ASC) AS engagement_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY core_workflow_events ASC) AS frequency_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY current_mrr ASC) AS monetary_score
    FROM active_snapshot
),
segmented AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN monetary_score >= 4 AND engagement_score >= 4 AND seat_utilization_pct >= 80
                THEN 'Expansion Ready Champions'
            WHEN engagement_score >= 4 AND frequency_score >= 3
                THEN 'Core Loyalists'
            WHEN monetary_score >= 3 AND (engagement_score <= 2 OR sla_breaches_90d >= 2)
                THEN 'At-Risk High Value'
            WHEN engagement_score <= 2 AND monetary_score <= 2
                THEN 'Hibernating / Low Adoption'
            ELSE 'Steady Adopters'
        END AS rfm_segment
    FROM rfm_quintiles
)
SELECT
    rfm_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS account_count,
    ROUND(SUM(current_arr), 2) AS total_arr,
    ROUND(AVG(current_mrr), 2) AS avg_mrr,
    ROUND(AVG(seat_utilization_pct), 1) AS avg_seat_utilization_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(feature_adoption_score), 1) AS avg_adoption_score,
    ROUND(AVG(sla_breaches_90d), 2) AS avg_sla_breaches_90d
FROM segmented
GROUP BY rfm_segment
ORDER BY total_arr DESC;

sql_presets.title: 05 — Acquisition Channel LTV, CAC & Payback Period
sql_presets.description: Gross-margin-adjusted SaaS LTV:CAC and CAC payback months across GTM channels.
sql_presets.sql:
-- =============================================================================
-- Query 05: Acquisition Channel Unit Economics (LTV, CAC, LTV:CAC & Payback)
-- Business Question: Which GTM acquisition channels generate the highest capital
-- efficiency (LTV:CAC >= 3.0x and CAC Payback < 14 months)?
-- =============================================================================

WITH account_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.acquisition_channel,
        a.segment,
        a.cac_usd,
        a.onboarding_completed,
        COUNT(m.month) AS observed_months,
        AVG(CASE WHEN m.is_active = 1 THEN m.ending_mrr END) AS avg_active_mrr,
        MAX(m.churn_flag) AS ever_churned
    FROM dim_accounts a
    INNER JOIN fact_mrr_monthly m
        ON a.account_id = m.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id, a.acquisition_channel, a.segment, a.cac_usd, a.onboarding_completed
),
channel_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        acquisition_channel,
        COUNT(*) AS total_accounts,
        ROUND(AVG(onboarding_completed) * 100.0, 1) AS onboarding_completion_pct,
        ROUND(AVG(cac_usd), 2) AS avg_cac_usd,
        ROUND(AVG(avg_active_mrr), 2) AS arpu_monthly_usd,
        -- Observed monthly logo churn rate per channel (bounded away from zero at 1.2% floor)
        MAX(0.012, SUM(ever_churned) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(observed_months), 0)) AS monthly_churn_rate
    FROM account_revenue
    GROUP BY acquisition_channel
)
SELECT
    acquisition_channel,
    total_accounts,
    onboarding_completion_pct,
    avg_cac_usd,
    arpu_monthly_usd,
    ROUND(monthly_churn_rate * 100.0, 2) AS monthly_churn_pct,
    -- Gross Margin Adjusted SaaS LTV (assuming 82% SaaS Gross Margin)
    ROUND((arpu_monthly_usd * 0.82) / monthly_churn_rate, 2) AS estimated_ltv_usd,
    ROUND(((arpu_monthly_usd * 0.82) / monthly_churn_rate) / NULLIF(avg_cac_usd, 0), 2) AS ltv_to_cac_ratio,
    ROUND(avg_cac_usd / NULLIF(arpu_monthly_usd * 0.82, 0), 1) AS cac_payback_months
FROM channel_metrics
ORDER BY ltv_to_cac_ratio DESC;

sql_presets.title: 06 — Multi-Factor Churn Risk Cohort Drivers
sql_presets.description: Cross-tabulates Billing Cadence x 14-Day Onboarding x Support SLA Breaches against lost ARR.
sql_presets.sql:
-- =============================================================================
-- Query 06: Multi-Factor Churn Risk Cohort Drivers (Onboarding x SLA x Cadence)
-- Business Question: Which operational combinations multiply customer churn risk?
-- =============================================================================

WITH account_summary AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.segment,
        a.billing_cadence,
        a.onboarding_completed,
        MAX(m.churn_flag) AS churned,
        ROUND(AVG(u.seat_utilization_pct), 1) AS avg_seat_utilization,
        COALESCE(SUM(t.sla_breached), 0) AS total_sla_breaches,
        ROUND(MAX(m.ending_mrr) * 12.0, 2) AS peak_arr
    FROM dim_accounts a
    INNER JOIN fact_mrr_monthly m
        ON a.account_id = m.account_id
    LEFT JOIN fact_product_usage u
        ON a.account_id = u.account_id
       AND m.month = u.month
    LEFT JOIN fact_support_tickets t
        ON a.account_id = t.account_id
       AND m.month = t.month
    GROUP BY a.account_id, a.segment, a.billing_cadence, a.onboarding_completed
),
bucketed AS (
    SELECT
        billing_cadence,
        CASE WHEN onboarding_completed = 1 THEN 'Completed (<14d)' ELSE 'Incomplete' END AS onboarding_status,
        CASE WHEN total_sla_breaches >= 2 THEN '2+ SLA Breaches' ELSE '0-1 SLA Breaches' END AS support_experience,
        churned,
        avg_seat_utilization,
        peak_arr
    FROM account_summary
)
SELECT
    billing_cadence,
    onboarding_status,
    support_experience,
    COUNT(*) AS cohort_accounts,
    SUM(churned) AS churned_accounts,
    ROUND((SUM(churned) * 100.0) / COUNT(*), 1) AS logo_churn_rate_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_seat_utilization), 1) AS avg_seat_utilization_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN churned = 1 THEN peak_arr ELSE 0 END), 2) AS lost_arr_usd
FROM bucketed
GROUP BY billing_cadence, onboarding_status, support_experience
ORDER BY logo_churn_rate_pct DESC;
